cases.input: The model processes input sequences of variable length. Each token is mapped to a dense embedding vector. The attention mechanism computes pairwise similarity scores. These scores determine the weighted combination of values. The output is passed through a feedforward network. Layer normalization is applied after each sub-layer. Residual connections help preserve gradient flow through layers.
